title: Under Falling Skies
subtitle: Solo Alien Invasion Dice-Placement Campaign
tagline: Lead Earth's subterranean resistance against a descending alien mothership in a replayable comic campaign.
loreSummary: The extraterrestrial mothership looms in the atmosphere, dropping hostile interceptors toward our besieged cities. As the commander of a subterranean bunker, place dice to excavate rooms, power anti-air lasers, advance vital research, and save the planet.
keyFeatures: Award-winning solo dice placement game with ingenious multi-use mechanics
Branching 4-chapter narrative campaign book featuring comic cutscenes and unlockable scenarios
Unlockable city sheets, character leaders, and innovative scenario modifiers
Winner of the 2020 Golden Geek Award for Best Solitaire Board Game

under_falling_skies_full_campaign.name: The 4-Chapter Comic Campaign (16 Missions)
under_falling_skies_full_campaign.description: The complete solo campaign arc across 4 sequential chapters with branching comic scenarios and unlockable base modules.

under_falling_skies_first_chapter.name: Chapter 1: The Descent Begins (4 Missions)
under_falling_skies_first_chapter.description: An introductory 4-mission story arc defending the first targeted cities and establishing basic bunker excavation lines.

under_falling_skies_hardcore_resistance.name: Global Veteran Resistance (All Cities & Hardcore)
under_falling_skies_hardcore_resistance.description: A grueling extended challenge defending every worldwide metropolis at maximum mothership threat levels.

milestones.title: The Mothership Arrives
milestones.description: Deploying underground excavators and initial anti-air lasers as the alien mothership descends over the city.

milestones.title: Defending Washington
milestones.description: Unlocking specialized character abilities and defensive robot companions to stave off intense swarm incursions.

milestones.title: Subterranean Research Breakout
milestones.description: Pushing scientific research tracks to decrypt alien tech and reverse-engineer heavy energy cannons.

milestones.title: Assault on the Core
milestones.description: Coordinating global city networks to launch an all-out offensive directly into the mothership's thermal reactor core.

milestones.title: Earth Reclaimed
milestones.description: Detonating the mothership and freeing humanity's cities from extraterrestrial subjugation.
